name: Labrador (Canada)
description: Three horizontal bands of white, green and blue, with a black spruce twig in the white band at the hoist.
history: Created in 1974 by Labrador MHA Mike Martin; universally flown in Labrador and the inspiration for several northern flags.

features.role: black spruce twig with three branches
features.symbolism: the three founding peoples of Labrador; the spruce, the land's oldest living thing
